title: [Review] Diff budget per ticket size
description: Count changed lines without tests, lockfiles and generated files: S ≤150 lines/5 files, M ≤400/12, L ≤800/25. Over budget: stop the Shift and propose a split. ADR-0010.

title: [Review] Pull requests explain themselves
description: What, why and how it works in plain language; one line per file; how to verify with real test output; glossary links. ADR-0010.

title: [Review] Reviewer Role rejects unrelated changes
description: One whole change per PR with a clean seam. ADR-0010.

title: [Review] Attention paths
description: Read .glide/attention and CODEOWNERS; label PRs touching them and list those files first. Agents may still change them. ADR-0010.

title: [Review] CI check: Glide review questions
description: Required check posts 3-5 questions to the reviewer; passes when all are answered or explicitly skipped; mismatches become fix-round feedback. ADR-0010.

title: [Pilot] Written confirmation of Glide ownership
description: Ask the employer's CTO to confirm in writing that Glide is the owner's own work under webgrip, used by the employer under Apache 2.0. Have a lawyer check the paragraph.

title: [Board] Work board in Vloer: backlog to accepted change
description: One screen: backlog, 'give to Ploeg', live progress, PR with feedback, preview, accept or reject. The first thing an agency owner sees. Owner's top pain: 'I can't see what's happening.'

title: [Board] Live Run view
description: Per ticket: current agent step, spend against the cap, logs, diff, elapsed time.

title: [Board] Accept or reject from the board
description: Accept, or close with a one-click reason (wrong scope, quality, not needed, done by hand). ADR-0006.

title: [Board] Kill switch
description: One button stops all Runs for an account. ADR-0005 trust features.

title: [Security] Confirm what the cluster runs
description: Flux reconciles from Forgejo; record the live Ploeg chart version and values. Credential plan step H0, ADR-0009.

title: [Security] Refuse isolation when CAP_SYS_PTRACE is present
description: Worker must detect the capability and refuse to claim isolation. Credential plan gap 1.

title: [Security] Proxies require the placeholder
description: LLM and forge loopback proxies must check the per-Run placeholder. Credential plan gap 3.

title: [Security] Fence forge proxy pushes to the Run's branch
description: Block base-branch pushes and merge/settings API routes. Credential plan gap 4.

title: [Security] Pin the worker securityContext
description: Drop capabilities, no privilege escalation, non-root. Add schema enums and golden renders for isolation flags.

title: [Security] Turn on credential isolation
description: PLOEG_LLM_KEY_ISOLATION=proxy and PLOEG_FORGE_TOKEN_ISOLATION=proxy after qualifying each harness. ADR-0034.

title: [Security] Default-deny egress for Run pods
description: Run pods reach only LiteLLM and their forge via the worker. ADR-0009.

title: [Security] Per-tenant egress gateway
description: Credentials outside the Run pod; placeholder swap at the gateway. Required before a second tenant shares a cluster. ADR-0009.

title: [Security] Qualify a sandboxed RuntimeClass
description: Test gVisor and Kata against each harness. ADR-0009.

title: [Security] Tenant on every record, LiteLLM team per tenant
description: Tenant id on Team, Work Item, Shift, credential; one LiteLLM team and budget per tenant. ADR-0009.

title: [Security] Cross-tenant isolation test in CI
description: A test Run tries to reach another tenant and dump its environment; all must fail. ADR-0009.

title: [Security] CVE scanning and patch policy
description: Scan every release; no known unpatched critical or high CVEs; publish a patch window. Cyber Resilience Act reporting for self-hosters.

title: [Security] Price a 3-node EU pilot cluster
description: Compare Hetzner, Scaleway and OVH for the dedicated pilot cluster. Decision #87.

title: [Billing] Meter tokens per attempt with tier markup
description: Provider cost plus 25/20/15% by tier, capped per ticket (S €4, M €10, L €20). Glide-fault failures not charged. ADR-0006.

title: [Billing] Delivery fee on acceptance
description: 1/3/8 credits (1 credit = one accepted S = €15) on merge, PR acceptance, or 10 working days after the PR opened. ADR-0006.

title: [Billing] Detect code taken without acceptance
description: After close: same commit, forge merge record or git patch-id bills after notice; weaker similarity opens a 10-working-day dispute. ADR-0006.

title: [Billing] Credit ledger
description: Prepaid start, postpaid after 10 accepted deliveries; paid credits never expire and are refunded on close; promotional credits expire and are used first.

title: [Billing] Markup tiers
description: 25% / 20% above median acceptance / 15% top quartile with 100 accepted; quarterly, at most one tier dropped, a month's notice.

title: [Billing] Per-ticket receipt
description: Tokens per attempt, markup, cap used, delivery fee, preview, and 'had you rejected you would have paid'. Invoices show the platform-fee split.

title: [Billing] Mollie and Lago
description: Mollie for payment, self-hosted Lago for metering; Ploeg enforces every cap before spend.

title: [Billing] Invoice export
description: Accepted tickets to Moneybird, Exact and e-Boekhouden. Part of the pilot.

title: [Billing] Credit refinement tokens on acceptance
description: Refinement tokens credited against the delivery fee if the ticket is accepted within 30 days.

title: [Intake] Refinement Role
description: Turns a request into a Work Item with Acceptance Conditions and a size; splits work above the L cap. ADR-0007.

title: [Intake] Ready-check with override
description: Marks tickets agent-ready; agency can override at its own risk. ADR-0007.

title: [Intake] Client approval gate
description: Client approves quote; agency can require its own approval. ADR-0007, Ploeg ADR-0031.

title: [Intake] Client profile
description: Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, extra instructions ranked below the delivery contract.

title: [Intake] Linear provider
description: Next tracker after Vikunja and ClickUp.

title: [Previews] Preview deploy action
description: CI step for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Forgejo Actions; Dockerfile first; deploy to own infra or Glide hosting. ADR-0008.

title: [Previews] Glide preview hosting
description: One deploy per credit for 7 days; €0.50 per extra deploy and per extra day; ingress free, 100 GB egress; signed client links. ADR-0008.

title: [KPIs] Agency dashboard
description: All 35 KPIs per agency, revenue per developer hour on the front page; agency picks what clients see.

title: [KPIs] Monthly public platform numbers
description: Anonymised medians, including those the markup tiers use.

title: [Portal] Client portal in Vloer
description: Submit, answer questions, approve, accept; per-client budgets; monthly report; email notifications. ADR-0005, ADR-0007.

title: [Pilot] Pick five Glide backlog tickets for the first runs
description: Small, clear, no tenancy or credential work. Measure delivery, tokens and review minutes.

title: [Pilot] Pilot paperwork
description: Pilot agreement, NDA and data processing agreement; lawyer and tax adviser review before the first invoice.

title: [Pilot] Check employment contract
description: Side-project, IP and non-compete clauses before offering Glide to your employer.
